About this item

【Powerful 2×1000w Motor Ebike】 This adult electric bicycle is designed to provide a powerful and thrilling riding experience. With two 1000W high-speed brushless motors, it can reach a maximum speed of 45-50km/h and continuously output strong power to tackle hills and challenging terrains with ease. This makes it perfect for off-road adventures and commuting in areas with varied terrain.There is a quick switch on the handlebar to switch between single drive or dual drive mode. On flat roads, you can use the single drive mode to get a longer range. When you go off-road or climb hills, switch to the dual drive mode to get surging power.

【Reliable Safety System】 The e-bike features a powerful front and rear hydraulic brake system that is designed to stop the bike quickly and smoothly, even at high speeds. Additionally, the system comes with a power-off function to provide an added layer of safety. The bike is equipped with 2pc larger and thicker 180mm disc rotors, which deliver more effective braking power for maximum control when going downhill. This feature instills confidence in riders, allowing them to enjoy a safe and worry-free ride.
【Fat Tire Electric Bike】 This city commuter e-bike is equipped with 26x4.0 inch fat tires that are specifically designed to handle any terrain or road condition. Whether you're traversing rocky beaches, snow-covered countryside, or climbing steep hills, these tires will provide the grip and stability you need for a smooth ride. Furthermore, the bike is powered by a high-capacity 48V 23Ah removable battery that delivers an impressive range of over 40 miles. This allows you to enjoy extended rides without worrying about running out of power, ensuring a relaxing and enjoyable experience from start to finish.

【Four Riding Modes】
This e-bike offers a range of riding modes to suit your preferences. You can choose between pure electric mode, pedal assist mode, classic bike mode, or even activate the cruise control mode for an effortless ride. Each mode has its own unique benefits, allowing you to enjoy a customized riding experience every time.
The smart display allows you to track your progress in real-time, so you always know your speed, distance, and battery level. For added convenience, there's also a USB charging port located at the bottom of the phone holder on the side, making it easy to keep your device charged while on the go. This allows you to share your journey with others or stay connected while enjoying your ride.

【Looking Forward to Your Riding Experience】
Our Men's electric bike is designed to make your journeys comfortable, sustainable, and hassle-free. With 85% pre-installation, you'll only need to manually attach some simple accessories like pedals, front wheel, handlebars, saddle, and headlights to get started on your adventures.
We understand the importance of reliability and durability when it comes to electric bikes, which is why we offer professional warranty services for every purchase. Our support team is always available to assist you with any concerns or issues that may arise.
Experience the joy of riding an electric bike and explore your surroundings in a whole new way. With our Men's electric bike, you can enjoy the freedom of effortless commutes, scenic routes, and exciting trails, all while reducing your carbon footprint.
